import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] line = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int h = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);

        double[][] dp = new double[36][36];
        for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 36; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int total_nodes = 1; total_nodes < 36; total_nodes++) {
            for (int minheight = 0; minheight <= total_nodes; minheight++) {
                for (int root = 1; root <= total_nodes; root++) {
                    int left_subtree = root - 1;
                    int right_subtree = total_nodes - root;
                    double term1 = dp[left_subtree][0] * dp[right_subtree][0];
                    double term2 = (dp[left_subtree][0] - dp[left_subtree][Math.max(minheight - 1, 0)]) *
                                   (dp[right_subtree][0] - dp[right_subtree][Math.max(minheight - 1, 0)]);
                    dp[total_nodes][minheight] += term1 - term2;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) dp[n][h]);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
